title: Mobile Command — Phone Controller
description: Phones as full Foundry clients with a touch-first UI replacement layer: per-player phone sheets, DM panel, shared-TV camera, combat music, effects, and private messages. Tested stack: Foundry 14 / dnd5e 5.3.3 / midi-qol 14.0.11 — see DESIGN.md (the module's System-health tab watches for unvalidated versions).

requires.reason: Runs every phone-triggered attack/spell through midi's workflow on the DM's client (the two-tap flow holds midi workflows mid-flight).
All phone-to-DM RPC rides socketlib; without it no phone action reaches the table.

recommends.reason: The phone's loot flow (open nearby piles, take items/coins) reuses Item Piles' machinery; without it, looting from the phone is unavailable.
Powers the advantage/disadvantage recommendation (and its named reasons) on the phone's attack screen; degrades to no recommendation without it.
The game clock chip, calendar button, watch/rest time labels, and travel day/night all read Simple Calendar (classic or Reborn — either works); without it there is no in-game time-of-day.
